name: build123d-studio
description: A standalone build123d IDE: Monaco, three-cad-viewer, Jupyter console and variable explorer

scripts.start: yarn build && node scripts/ensure-neutralino.mjs && neu run -- --window-enable-inspector=true
scripts.package:dev: node scripts/dev-build.mjs --next && yarn package:build && yarn package
scripts.package:build: node scripts/ensure-neutralino.mjs && vite build --mode production && node scripts/copy-client-lib.mjs && neu build --release
